title: 5.2.3 Lab: Tune Gravity
description: Try different world.gravity.y values on the same scene and describe how each one feels. Non-graded: discuss with a partner.

steps.title: Try several gravity values
steps.instructions: Change world.gravity.y to 10, then 0, then -5, then 20. Run the sketch after each change and notice how the player moves.
hints: Search the moSHion docs drawer for world.gravity.

steps.title: Describe what you noticed
steps.instructions: For each value, describe in a sentence what it felt like: did the player fall, float, or drift upward? Fast or slow?
